narration.prompt: [quietly] The summer I turned fifteen, I watched a white hat drift along the top of my grandparents' hedge. That hedge is eight feet tall. [long pause] When I told Grandpa, the colour left his face. By dark they had sealed me upstairs. Paper over every window. A bowl of salt in each corner. [long pause] [whispers] "Don't open that door before sunrise. Whatever you hear." [long pause] Around two, the salt started turning black. Then something tapped on every window at once. On the second floor. [long pause] Then, through the door, Grandpa's voice. [long pause] But Grandpa was sitting right beside me. [whispers] And he was shaking his head. [long pause] At dawn they drove me out of the valley. She walked beside the car the whole way, bent down to my window. [whispers] I didn't look. Not once.
narration.takes_note: both takes (801 credits each); take 1 used (51.2 s raw; inner pauses capped at 0.22 s), take 2 kept (50.6 s)

door_voice.prompt: [softly, kind] It's all over now. [short pause] You can come out. [short pause] [gently] Open the door for Grandpa.

sfx_first_run_note: The first run put the duration in the prompt text, which does not set it: 7 prompts x 4 variations came back 1-16 s (about 476 credits). All are kept: ep51-short-cicadas/popo/room/car-*, and ep51-tap-*, ep51-tear-*, ep51-salt-* (the tear and salt were used from this run).

cicadas-loop.prompt: Japanese countryside on a hot summer afternoon: a dense chorus of higurashi and minmin cicadas in the trees, a faint breeze through a tall hedge, very distant crows, no music, no voices.

room-loop.prompt: Inside a sealed tatami room at night: a low, pressurised, uneasy drone with a slow pulse, faint wind pressing against paper-covered windows, wooden house creaking very softly. Dark ambient, no melody.

popo.prompt: A deep, hollow, breathy voice outside a house at night slowly repeating "po... po... po..." - low, wooden, almost like air blown across a bottle, unhuman and patient, close to a window. Dry, no reverb tail, no music.

taps.prompt: Long fingernails tapping on glass behind newspaper, fast, moving from one window to the next all around a small room, then all windows at once, at night, close and dry.

car-loop.prompt: Interior of an old small car driving slowly on a gravel country road at dawn, engine idling low, tyres crunching gravel, windows closed, birds faint outside, no music.

tear.prompt: A single violent rip of newspaper torn off a window frame, sharp and close, with a low hollow thud underneath, horror stinger, dry, then silence.

salt.prompt: Fine grains of salt in a ceramic bowl crackling and hissing softly as they darken, like something burning without flame, quiet and close, in a silent room.

picks: cicadas-1 (steadiest), room-2 (loudest and steadiest), popo-2, taps-3 (quiet; layered with synthesized nail clicks), car-4, tear-4, salt-2; by measurement, not listening
